name: 西安交通大学
character: The square-shaped main campus features symmetrical Sino-Soviet style gray-brick buildings with red-tile roofs, ivy-covered facades, and avenues lined with tall plane trees and flower gardens.

landmarks.name: 钱学森图书馆
landmarks.quote: 1995年，图书馆经钱学森本人同意及中宣部批准改名钱学森图书馆
landmarks.look: Three-story Sino-Soviet north wing connected to a 13-story pyramid-shaped south wing.

landmarks.name: 老教学主楼群
landmarks.quote: 老教学主楼群修建于1956年到1958年...以中心大楼为主体
landmarks.look: Symmetrical Sino-Soviet gray-brick buildings with red-tile gable roofs and ivy.

landmarks.name: 新教学主楼群
landmarks.quote: 教学主楼群是校园南北中轴线上最后建设的项目...由A至E五座组成
landmarks.look: Five-building complex with low lecture halls and a tall central office tower.

landmarks.name: 北门
landmarks.quote: 北校门、中心教学楼和图书馆等重要建筑均沿南北中轴线布置
landmarks.look: Main campus gate positioned along the north-south central axis.

landmarks.name: 东花园
landmarks.quote: 校园内东西花园大面积的牡丹、芍药、月季、樱花等不同品种的花卉不同时间竞相开放
landmarks.look: Campus garden filled with peonies, roses, and cherry blossoms.

landmarks.name: 西花园
landmarks.quote: 校园内东西花园大面积的牡丹、芍药、月季、樱花等不同品种的花卉不同时间竞相开放
landmarks.look: Campus garden filled with peonies, roses, and cherry blossoms.
